party.note: Two couples plus one five-year-old. Two rooms; the child shares with parents.

budget.note: All-in group budget for 5 travelers across flights, hotel, transport, and activities.

preferences.note: The group has ruled out pre-dawn return flights — nothing departing OGG before about 10 AM on the way home.

constraint: The first week of August is peak season on Maui. The full August package prices out around $15,356 — roughly $3,356 over the group's $12,000 budget. The same trip in the first week of October (shoulder season) comes in near $11,798, inside budget.
